deviations_from_previous_r2_build: github.com was unreachable mid-round; frugally-deep v0.15.31, FunctionalPlus v0.2.25 and googletest v1.17.0 were prefetched from codeload.github.com and verified byte-exact against the URL_HASH values declared in cmake/ThirdParty.cmake (49bf5e30..., 9b5e24bb..., 65fab701...); they were injected via FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_* so CMake's own download-time hash check did not execute - the manual sha256 verification substitutes for it

CMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES defaulted to gfx906 (b56p recorded none). No effect on validated paths: the regression and kthvalue kernels compile at runtime through hipRTC with -mcpu=gfx1151 from the live device query; no offline GPU code objects are exercised by the validated tests
C language enabled implicitly via BUILD_TESTING=ON (b56p had it too; recorded here because the C compiler vars appear in the cache diff)
build.configure_attempts_note: five preliminary configure attempts failed in sequence before the successful one: (1) wrong ROCm root via base-conda hipconfig PATH leak; (2) FetchContent hang on frugally-deep when github.com became unreachable; (3) half-populated eigen3 cache after a partial rerun; (4) BUILD_TESTING/MIOPEN_TEST_DISCRETE omitted so no test targets existed; (5) MIOPEN_USE_COMPOSABLEKERNEL left at its ON default so a CK package was required. Each attempt's log was overwritten by the next - only the final successful configure log is archived. No source file was touched by any attempt
